_comment: One integer unit follows B's match_engine/config/pairs.json (team decision 19 Nov): price_decimals 2, qty_decimals 6, and the same tick and lot as B and D. A quote asset's decimals must equal price_decimals + qty_decimals, so that price x qty is exact; hence USDT has 8. min_qty, max_qty and max_notional are A's own limits (100 BTC, 1000 ETH, 1,000,000 USDT per order).
